messages.content:
Given a question and an answer, analyze the complexity of each sentence in the answer. Break down each sentence into one or more fully understandable statements. Ensure that no pronouns are used in any statement. Format the outputs in JSON.
Please return the output in a JSON format that complies with the following schema as specified in JSON Schema:
{"properties": {"statements": {"description": "The generated statements", "items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Statements", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["statements"], "title": "StatementGeneratorOutput", "type": "object"}Do not use single quotes in your response but double quotes,properly escaped with a backslash.

--------EXAMPLES-----------
Example 1
Input: {
    "question": "Who was Albert Einstein and what is he best known for?",
    "answer": "He was a German-born theoretical physicist, widely acknowledged to be one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time. He was best known for developing the theory of relativity, he also made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics."
}
Output: {
    "statements": [
        "Albert Einstein was a German-born theoretical physicist.",
        "Albert Einstein is recognized as one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time.",
        "Albert Einstein was best known for developing the theory of relativity.",
        "Albert Einstein also made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics."
    ]
}
-----------------------------

Now perform the same with the following input
input: {
    "question": "user: What impact will future advancements in AI have on information retrieval?\nassistant: Future advancements in AI are expected to significantly impact information retrieval. There are many ways to run queries and the different operations used can impact performance. IBM Watson Discovery uses AI-powered search, retrieval, and content mining to transform data into valuable insights. As AI technology continues to evolve, we can expect improved capabilities in understanding content, including tables and images. Interpreting data, collections, fields, and enrichments. Also identifying relevant information, and providing more accurate and insightful answers to queries. \nuser: Use AI for shopping?\nassistant: The retailer is faced with strong competitive pressures. AI can be used in various ways for shopping. For instance, AI-powered chatbots can assist customers with their shopping needs. A smarter shopping experience is needed to increase customer retention. The retailer must also provide customers with useful content, such as product information, alternative product information, reviews, and real-time inventory visibility. \nuser: How do I train AI to search for items unique to my business?\nassistant: IBM Watson® Discovery is an intelligent document processing engine that helps you to gain insights from complex business documents.\nUse Discovery to visually train AI for deep understanding of your content, including tables and images, to help you find business value that is hidden in your enterprise data. Discovery uses AI-powered search, retrieval, and content mining. It explains how to upload your data and query for answers, find insights, and spot trends. Watson Discovery is made up of four main concepts: projects, collections, fields, and enrichments.\nuser: What is a Watson Discovery project?\nassistant: A Watson Discovery project is a space where you can import different types of data from various sources and query for insights or answers. It is one of the four main concepts of Watson Discovery. A project can be used to build an AI-powered search function, or spot trends across large volumes of text-heavy business data. This project type can help to increase productivity, minimize costs, and reduce your legal exposure.\nuser: What are the other three Watson Discovery concepts?",
    "answer": "文档提到 Watson Discovery 的四个主要概念是项目、集合、字段和 enrichments；但没有说明除项目之外的三个概念分别是什么。"
}
Output:

statements: 文档提到 Watson Discovery 的四个主要概念是项目、集合、字段和 enrichments。
文档没有说明 Watson Discovery 中除项目之外的三个主要概念分别是什么。
